body:
I looked into Kratom earlier this week on a website. Decided I'd buy 8 grams of a 'premium powdered extract'
I had just come from the skatepark, and after a long day of hard falls, scrapes, rolls, and slams, I hurt. Worst of all, I needed a shower, and I had a couple bad scrapes from sliding on cement.
I took about 2 grams at first, mixed it with a monster Energy Drink, about 15 minutes inbetween.
I could lie down easily, something that wouldn't have been possible if I had not have taken the Kratom. It was nice and relaxing and I watched a movie on netflix.
Decided to go to the shower, hopped in and got ready for some intense pain on my wounds. Much to my surprise, the pain was cut in half, what would have stung, and made me clench in pain felt like a gentle tickle.
I figure'd I'd experiment with it a little bit. Put some in a water pipe with a smoking blend of herbs, nothing too stimulating.
I did not get much effect from smoking, It had an effect, for sure, but it was such a small quantity (perhaps 1 gram, half a gram) that I couldnt notice any major effects other than the warmness and relaxed feeling.
In summary, it's nice. For the price I paid, not worth it in my opinion, I can deal with having painful showers, however, it was nice for a recovery from a hard day.
